description: This file defines a set of custom exception classes related to inventory management, including NotFound, InsufficientAvailable, and InvalidQuantity exceptions.

classes.name: InventoryExceptions
classes.description: A utility class containing nested exception classes for inventory-related errors.

classes.name: InventoryExceptions.NotFound
classes.description: Exception thrown when an inventory item is not found.

classes.name: InventoryExceptions.InsufficientAvailable
classes.description: Exception thrown when inventory stock is insufficient.

classes.name: InventoryExceptions.InvalidQuantity
classes.description: Exception thrown for invalid quantity input in inventory operations.

methods.description: Constructor for creating a NotFound exception with a message.

methods.description: Constructor for creating an InsufficientAvailable exception with a message.
